scope_outcomes.criterion: A direct passage in the supplied citing text identifies a work, idea, or named thinker cited by Riley and supplies a supporting predicate and, where available, a cited locus.
scope_outcomes.basis: The supplied article directly attributes claims about mass suffrage, representative government, and Caesarism to Max Weber and identifies the cited work as Appendix II of Economy and Society, with loci at pp. 1407–10 and 1452.
limitations: This outcome covers only the supplied article, not Riley’s complete work or Weber’s entire reception.
The article’s general references to Weber without a separate work citation were not treated as additional work-level findings.
